question: The Amazon River, considered the largest river in the world, with a length of 6,400 km, is located in the northern part of _______
solution:
The correct answer is** __South America__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Amazon is well known for a number of reasons. It is the greatest river of South America.
 
• The largest drainage system** in the world in terms of the volume of its flow and the area of its basin**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Amazon River is located in the northern portion of South America, flowing from west to east.
 
• The river system originates in the Andes Mountains of Peru and travels through Ecuador, Colombia, Venezuela, Bolivia, and Brazil before emptying into the Atlantic Ocean.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.britannica.com/40/89840-004-907E0FA0.jpg]
